name: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd
description: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HINDPETRO) is an energy enterprise operating across the hydrocarbon value chain, spanning upstream crude oil exploration, natural gas processing, refining, and petroleum product retailing. company_profile.summary: Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HINDPETRO) is an energy enterprise operating across the hydrocarbon value chain, spanning upstream crude oil exploration, natural gas processing, refining, and petroleum product retailing. Crucial to India's energy security, the corporation supplies high-quality transportation fuels, piped natural gas (PNG), and compressed natural gas (CNG) for industrial and vehicular consumption.

revenue_breakup.desc: Motor spirit (petrol), high-speed diesel, aviation turbine fuel (ATF), and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG).
CNG for commercial/private vehicles and piped natural gas (PNG) for households and industries.
Polypropylene, benzene, automotive motor oils, and industrial grease formulations.

moats_and_strengths: Unsurpassable distribution network of company-owned and dealer-operated retail fuel outlets.
Cross-country crude and refined product pipeline networks providing lowest-cost bulk transportation.
Captive coastal and inland refining facilities with high operational complexity.
Strategic sovereign importance with strong state support for energy infrastructure build-outs.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: Refining Capacity > 15 MMTPA • 10,000+ Retail Fuel Outlets • Pipeline Network > 3,000 km

bullish_triggers: Expanding city gas distribution networks and rising adoption of clean natural gas in urban mobility.
Healthy domestic demand for diesel, petrol, and jet fuel driven by economic activity.
bearish_risks: Government intervention in retail pump pricing during inflationary crude oil spikes.
Global gross refining margin (GRM) volatility and windfall taxes during geopolitical disruptions.

liquidation_safety.pledge_deadline: 9:00 PM on T-day (Mandatory CDSL/NSDL OTP authorization)
